responsibility: Declares a small gimplification-time helper class used specifically while validating and lowering extended asm operands and constraints. The class tracks hard-register usage across asm constraint alternatives, outputs, inputs, early-clobber operands, explicit clobber lists, and fixed register-asm operands using HARD_REG_SET data, and provides overlap tests that account for the operand’s machine mode; gimplify code uses it to detect invalid or conflicting register assignments among asm outputs, inputs, alternatives, and clobbers during conversion to GIMPLE.
